fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Signatures drawn on any screen

Signers draw with a finger or a mouse. The form stamps the date and time, writes the signature into a PDF of the waiver and emails that copy to the signer for their records.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A kayak renter initials the capsize and cold-water clauses and signs on a phone, and booking #2318 clears for paddles once all 3 adult renters have signed.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A volunteer roster for the Wendover cleanup shows 34 of 40 waivers signed, reminds the unsigned volunteers by email, and posts the 6 names to the cleanup crew's Slack channel.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A climber waiver asks for date of birth first, adds a guardian section for a 12-year-old climber, and her mother signs on her behalf before the waiver is saved to the climber's record.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A vendor table for Gristmill Street Lofts lists each contractor's insurance certificate end date, flags two certificates ending within 30 days and emails Thornbury Electric for a new one.

afb---cover-image.alt: Liability waiver form: the confirmation a renter sees after signing a waiver, with a button to download a signed copy

thumbnail-image.alt: Build a liability waiver form people sign online, with Emergent
